label: Best option, best quality, and perfect making
term: best option, best quality, and perfect making
resolution: PartialOrder antisymmetry identifies equal greatest quality values; it does not identify the candidates mapped to them. Candidate uniqueness is a separate quantified hypothesis. Fixed feasible options are not simultaneously existent creations. Totality concerns positive selected effects and excludes the no-creation rival within this formal scope. Perfect manner of making is not identified with maximizing the quality of the product. Monadology §§53–55 supplies a best-creation rationale, not the formal uniqueness/totality package; ST I q25a6 reply3 supports a better-other-universe reply, not universal strict improvability of every admissible option. See the materialized source readings in docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md.
